gztell.reason: Returns a numeric offset value (z_off_t), not a pointer, so ownership does not apply; the function merely queries the current position of an existing gzFile handle.

gzprintf.reason: Returns an int (no pointer ownership applies), but the variadic argument list makes this function unsafe to expose directly in a binding.

adler32_combine.reason: The function returns a plain integer value (uLong), not a pointer, so ownership does not apply.

gzeof.reason: gzeof returns a plain int status value and does not allocate or transfer ownership of any pointer; it merely queries internal state of the library-owned gzFile handle.

inflateInit_.reason: inflateInit_ initialises a caller-supplied z_stream struct (no pointer is returned); the function returns an int status code, so ownership of a returned pointer does not apply.

crc32_combine_gen.reason: The function returns a uLong value (not a pointer), so ownership does not apply; it simply computes and returns a scalar CRC combination operator.

adler32_z.reason: The function returns a uLong checksum value, not a pointer, so ownership and lifecycle concepts do not apply; it is a pure computation safe to expose.

get_crc_table.reason: Returns a pointer to a static internal table (crc_table) owned by the library; the caller must not free it.

adler32.reason: adler32 returns a uLong checksum value (not a pointer), so ownership does not apply; it is a pure computation function safe to expose.

deflate.reason: deflate returns an int status code, not a pointer, so ownership does not apply; it operates on a caller-supplied z_streamp handle managed by deflateInit/deflateEnd.
